company.name: Anto Bio
company.shortDescription: Anto is a full stack biology AI company, developing the first generation of multi-omic foundation models for the human microbiome.
company.description: Anto develops AI-driven infrastructure for precision medicine, utilizing quality-aware sparsification algorithms and lab-in-the-loop validation to separate signal from noise in complex biological data and build multimodal foundation models for microbial communities. The company's platform allows researchers to forecast ecosystem dynamics and simulate counterfactual outcomes, unlocking the billion-dollar data blind spot in drug development to prevent adverse reactions and improve therapeutic success rates.
